taylor: Morning! first-day panic — set up asdf via brew but fish isn't picking up shims. installed nodejs plugin and ran asdf install nodejs 18.17.0 but `node -v` returns "command not found".
Output of `ls -la ~/.asdf/shims` shows shims there. My config.fish is basically default.

samir: OS?

taylor: macbook pro, arm, macOS 13.6. Brew path is /opt/homebrew. I installed asdf with `brew install asdf`

anya: ah! fish needs the fish-specific init. Try adding this to ~/.config/fish/config.fish:

```
# asdf + fish
set -x PATH $HOME/.asdf/shims $HOME/.asdf/bin $PATH
source (brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.fish
# direnv hook (if you use direnv)
eval (direnv hook fish)
```

samir: also run `asdf reshim` after install. And check `which node` and `echo $PATH` in a new shell.

jen: if you used our dotfiles repo, make sure your SSH key is added to github so the repo's envrcs get pulled. ping @infra if you need access.

taylor: added the source line and PATH tweak, `asdf reshim` and restarted terminal — node's there now, thanks :tada:

infra-bot: docs: https://intranet.redwoodinference.com/onboarding/dev-setup — contains fish+asdf snippets and dotfiles access steps.

taylor: awesome, closing this thread. will file a tiny PR to the new-hire checklist to call out fish specifics.
